Lessons from the Week 3 run

    Symptom: Both misses were typed ingredient fields where I used everyday wording instead of the site's pantry name ("green onion" for "scallion", "cilantro" for "coriander").
    What finally worked: For typed ingredients, use the name the pantry list uses. Check the "Did you mean" box after a miss, which lists accepted names.
    Section: Choosing meals.
    Nothing else went wrong. The Next day, Save day and Backspace steps worked as described, and repeated meals were handled correctly.
